components.css: .ds-hero { max-width:56rem; padding:3rem 2rem; color:var(--ink, #151515); font-family:sans-serif; } .ds-hero-label { margin:0 0 1.6rem; color:var(--blue, #174bd6); font-size:.74rem; font-weight:720; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-hero h1 { max-width:16ch; margin:0; font-size:clamp(2.45rem,5.3vw,5rem); font-weight:680; line-height:1.04; letter-spacing:-.04em; } .ds-hero.is-zh { font-family:"Noto Sans SC Profile",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.01em; } .ds-hero.is-zh h1 { max-width:18ch; font-size:clamp(2.3rem,4.2vw,4rem); line-height:1.12; } .ds-hero-bio { max-width:68ch; margin-top:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem); color:#42464d; font-size:clamp(1rem,1.25vw,1.15rem); line-height:1.65; } .ds-hero-bio p { margin:0; } .ds-hero-bio p + p { margin-top:.9rem; }

components.name: Primary Email Action
components.description: The compact cobalt contact action used in the hero and final contact section.
components.html: Email Hu Jiao
components.css: .ds-email-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:1.25rem; width:fit-content; padding:.85rem 1rem; background:var(--blue, #174bd6); color:#fff; border-radius:.25rem; font:650 .92rem/1.4 sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 180ms ease; } .ds-email-action svg { width:1.25rem; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; } .ds-email-action:hover { background:var(--blue-dark, #123ca9); } .ds-email-action:hover svg { transform:translateX(.25rem); } .ds-email-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #ffbf47); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Language Switcher
components.css: .ds-language-switcher { display:inline-flex; padding:2px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #c9cdd5); border-radius:999px; background:var(--soft, #f5f7fb); } .ds-language-switcher button { min-width:2.8rem; min-height:2.75rem; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#555b65; font:650 .78rem/1 sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms ease,color 180ms ease; } .ds-language-switcher button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--blue, #174bd6); color:#fff; } .ds-language-switcher button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #ffbf47); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Quiet sticky navigation with a cobalt current-section underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:stretch; min-height:4.5rem; background:rgba(255,255,255,.97); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #dfe2e8); } .ds-nav a { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 .8rem; color:#3d4148; font:600 .83rem/1 sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:.8rem; right:.8rem; bottom:0; height:3px; background:var(--blue, #174bd6); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current="location"] { color:var(--blue, #174bd6); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="location"]::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus, #ffbf47); outline-offset:-5px; }

narrative.overview:
The site presents Hu Jiao as a person and practitioner through the quiet authority of a beautifully typeset professional dossier. White paper, graphite typography, a restrained cobalt accent, and exact hairline rules make the experience calm, credible, and easy to scan rather than promotional or job-board-like.

The system is spacious but information-dense where a résumé needs precision. Its identity comes from the asymmetric profile composition, bilingual typography, and disciplined structural lines—not photography, illustration, ornamental effects, or technological decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Personal thesis and biography lead on the left; localized name and concise facts occupy the Composition B rail on the right.
Restrained cobalt is reserved for navigation state, labels, and primary contact actions.
Self-hosted Manrope and Noto Sans SC, with exactly one language-specific name shown at a time.
Flat white and cool-gray surfaces separated by one-pixel hairlines.
Responsive editorial grids that collapse into a linear reading flow.
No shipping imagery; the approved composition is an internal reference only.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only expressive hue and stays concentrated in state, navigation, and contact affordances; broad content fields remain quiet.

rules.name: The Bilingual Measure Rule
rules.body: Treat Chinese as authored typography: switch the family order, preserve natural spacing, and adjust measure and display scale instead of inserting translations into English metrics unchanged.

rules.name: The Flat Dossier Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest; use tone and hairline structure, never floating cards or ambient shadow, to separate information.

dos: Do keep the personal thesis and biography on the left and the localized name with facts in the right rail.
Do reserve cobalt for meaningful emphasis and interaction state.
Do use generous whitespace, 60–68ch text measures, and tabular dates for scanning.
Do preserve natural English and Simplified Chinese typography as equal first-class layouts.
Do use one-pixel rules and tonal panels to organize résumé information.
Do keep all interactions keyboard-visible and respect reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, heavy shadows, decorative tech motifs, or floating card grids.
Don't show English and Chinese names simultaneously; render only the active language's restrained rail identity.
Don't add portraits, logos, stock photography, or other shipping imagery without supplied and approved source material.
Don't spread cobalt across large content areas or add competing accent hues.
Don't force Chinese copy into English tracking, casing, or line-length assumptions.
Don't fabricate contact channels, testimonials, metrics, or credentials.
